text: {"danger_level":"orange","danger_reason":"A city-wide alert is active because shaking has stopped, but aftershocks are expected and damage should be checked.","main_move":"MOVE_TO_OPEN_AREA","main_move_text":"If your building is damaged, get out to an open area","where_to_go":"Go SSE to Open area (park or ground), which is 331 m away (about 4.4 walking minutes).","do_now":[{"text":"Be ready to Drop, Cover, and Hold On if you feel an aftershock.","advice_ids":["eq.aftershocks"]},{"text":"Stay away from damaged structures, gas leaks, and downed power lines.","advice_ids":["eq.damaged_building","eq.hazards_after"]},{"text":"Check yourself for injuries and help others if you have training.","advice_ids":["eq.help_others"]},{"text":"Follow local emergency news reports once you reach safety.","advice_ids":["eq.news"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not enter damaged buildings.","advice_ids":["eq.damaged_building"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"trapped","text":"Send a text or bang on a pipe or wall, and use a whistle instead of shouting.","advice_ids":["eq.trapped"]}],"call":["112 - Emergency"],"confidence":"medium","confidence_reason":"The alert is city-wide and actual building damage or shaking strength cannot be determined from map data alone.","unknowns":["Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals (emergency tag or large campus); their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","SafeGround cannot predict shaking strength at a spot; the plan covers protective actions only.","Open areas are mapped parks, pitches and grounds (OpenStreetMap); their condition after an earthquake is unknown.","Building damage cannot be seen from map data; after shaking, judge your own building and follow officials."],"valid_while":["Until officials confirm buildings are safe; aftershocks are expected"]}
